content:
Every AI agent, every protocol, every transaction. One company. Sound familiar? It should. You lived this with Shopify Payments.

In this issue

  • How the Payment Layer Works. The technical innovation at the center is the Shared Payment Token (SPT).
  • Why This Should Worry You. Almost 75% of NRF retailers are either implementing or actively planning agentic commerce initiatives (Stripe Blog, January 2026).
  • The Shopify Payments Parallel. With Shopify Payments, merchants gave up payment flexibility for platform convenience.
  • Due Diligence. I'm not saying don't use Stripe for agentic commerce.
  • The Counter-Argument. There is a case for a single infrastructure layer.
  • What I'd Tell You Right Now. Do your homework. Stripe's Agentic Commerce Suite is the best product in this space today.
